title: Ultrasound-based radiomics for early predicting response to neoadjuvant chemotherapy in patients with breast cancer: a systematic review with meta-analysis
access: Publisher abstract and subscription preview only; full review not accessible
summary: The review searched four databases through 1 January 2023 and included eight studies. It assessed methods using RQS and QUADAS-2; mean RQS was 12.88 (35.8% of the maximum). Pooled sensitivity was 0.87 (95% CI 0.81–0.92), specificity 0.78 (0.72–0.83). It described potential predictive usefulness while calling for rigorous multicenter prospective confirmation because the evidence was limited and methodologically weak. These are abstract-level findings, not a full-text methodological audit.
